transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Ellie. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Ellie. My TV remote has stopped working properly, half the buttons don't do anything and it's quite annoying.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's annoying, I'm sorry, Oskar. Let's get it sorted. Can I take your PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. So your TV remote has partly stopped working and half the buttons do nothing. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll send you a replacement remote today. Can I confirm the delivery address is still 3 Station Road?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Would you like it sent first class, or is standard post okay?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's ordered. It should arrive in two to three days, and it pairs automatically when you press the two blue buttons together for three seconds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Has the order email come through to you?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. When the new remote arrives and you've paired it, does that cover everything you needed today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Oskar. Have a good day.
